newsitem.title: UK: UK furniture retailer Heal's poised to float - paper.
newsitem.headline: UK furniture retailer Heal's poised to float - paper.

text.p: British upmarket home furnishing retailer Heal's will raise 12 million pounds ($19.32 million) in a stock market listing later this month, with first dealings expected on March 24, The Times said on Friday.
The flotation would enable NatWest Ventures to sell its holding and allow management shareholders, who bought out Heal's from Storehouse in 1990, to sell part of their holdings, the paper said.

The Times said Heal's made pre-tax profits of 1.8 million pounds ($2.90 million) in the 53 weeks to September 14 and 1.6 million pounds ($2.58 million) in the 20 weeks to February 1, the period in which it makes 90 percent of its full year operating profits.
